description: This file contains a Java class named JmsBasedCredentialsClient, which is a client implementation for interacting with a Credentials service via JMS. It provides methods to create instances, send credential GET requests, and handle responses, including error handling.

classes.name: JmsBasedCredentialsClient
classes.description: A client for interacting with a Credentials service implementation via JMS, providing methods to retrieve credentials and handle responses.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new JmsBasedCredentialsClient instance wrapped in a Future.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials of a specified type and authId, optionally with client context.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a JMS request message with specified parameters and processes the response.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Processes the response payload and status to produce a CredentialsResult object.
